main_body: Flat-roofed sandstone building: a large sand-coloured roof terrace with a teal dome on top, over a brick front wall with an arched door and a lattice window
top_band: Sand/tan roof terrace with speckle texture, rows ~3-33 (lighter front lip at rows ~31-33), parapet rim around the edges
evidence: Reading a column through the middle: the top surface is a wide sand roof with a raised parapet (rows 3-30), a light front-edge lip (rows 31-33), a dark brown eave shadow (rows 34-35), then the brick front face with mortar courses (rows 36-65). The roof surface is large and clearly horizontal, and the dome sits on it. The door has a pale frame and dark planks, and the window has a sill and dark lattice, so they read as inset. Both a top surface and a front face are drawn, so it is a 3/4 object.

style.evidence: The outlines are dark brown beside the sand and brick, not black. The dome has about 5 teal steps with facets. The sand roof has speckle and grain, and the brick has per-brick tone variation and mortar lines. Some areas are plainer than the reference: the dome base band and parts of the roof border are flat, and there is less fine tile detail than the reference houses. It would sit acceptably next to the reference, so it passes.
